         ANTIMONIUM ARSENICOSUM

       Arsenite of Antimony


Found useful in   emphysema with excessive dyspnœa
      and cough, much mucous secretion. Worse on eating and lying down. Catarrhal pneumonia
      associated with influenza. Myocarditis and cardiac weakness. Pleurisy, especially of left
      side,   with exudation   and pericarditis, with effusion.
      Sense of weakness. Inflammation of eyes and œdema of face.



Dose.--  Third trituration.
